create.faq.q1: How to create an open letter?
create.faq.q1.response: We recommend you to start a google doc with one or two other people. It's a co-creation process! Once you are happy with it, copy paste it here, publish it and share the URL with your collaborators to be the first to sign it.
create.faq.q2.response: An open letter is a great way to ask something to your company, organization, institution, city, government. Make sure that it is signed by people that are relevant to what you are asking.
create.faq.q3: Can I limit who can sign it?
create.faq.q3.response: No. That's why we recommend you to carefully share it to the right people at the beginning, so that they will get the opportunity to be first people showing up as the co-signatories.
create.text:
Copy paste or write your open letter here.

Pro tip: you can use the markdown syntax to format your text with **bold** or *italic*.

faq.q1.response: A public statement of support from MSEG's community. Signing adds your name (or "Anonymous" plus your role) to the list of signers below.
faq.q2.response: Anyone in the OUSD community: parents and guardians, students, teachers, staff, administrators, elected officials and community members. Pick the role that describes you best.
faq.q3: Why do I need to provide an email address?
faq.q3.response: To avoid abuse. Each signature is linked to an actual email address that you confirm by clicking a link. We don't keep your email address unless you explicitly opted in to receive updates.
faq.q4.response: There are no cookies, trackers or ads on this page. We only ask for your email address to confirm your signature (see above). Read the privacy notice linked in the footer.
faq.q5: Can I sign without showing my name?
faq.q5.response: Yes. Untick "Display my name publicly" and you will be listed as "Anonymous" with your role. Your name is still recorded so MSEG can verify signatures.
faq.q8: How do I edit or remove my signature?
faq.q8.response: Your confirmation email contains a unique link to edit your signature; keep it safe and don't share it. To remove your signature, email MSEG using the contact address in the privacy notice.
